hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored kpssTest reproduces the statsmodels.tsa.stattools.kpss(regression='c') statistic BIT-FOR-BIT; the statistic lies below the 5% KPSS critical value (so it fails to reject the stationarity null); and this AGREES with the ADF test (which rejects the unit-root null), so the confirmatory pair concurs the segment is stationary.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: kpssTest equals statsmodels kpss to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the statistic is below the 5% critical value and agrees with ADF
